required scenes (story order):
S1: in ancient times, people did not know which plants can be eaten, so people often got sick after eating some plants
    the teacher's past decisions on other learners' versions of this scene -- accepted as told: 他看到很多人很病了 | 在中国古代很多人生病了 | 古代很多人不知道什么可以吃。
S2: 神农decided to find out which plants are safe to eat and which are not, so he climbed mountains to try different plants
    the teacher's past decisions on other learners' versions of this scene -- accepted as told: 所以他走路旅行找足多不同的植物 | 所以神农走了很长的时间找到植物药。 | 所以他爬山找解药。在他的旅行，神农发现很多植物。
S3: 神农found茶and took a record
    the teacher's past decisions on other learners' versions of this scene -- accepted as told: 他找到了茶 | 他一吃就知道那个植物是茶。 | 他找到很好吃的植物，比方说茶。 ; flagged as missing: 喝茶对你的身体有好处 | 他到山以后，他喝了茶。
S4: 神农tried 夹竹桃 and fainted
    the teacher's past decisions on other learners' versions of this scene -- accepted as told: 他吃了花，就肚子疼。 | 吃着夹竹桃的以后，他病得很。 | 但一吃就病了。特别是夹竹桃。 ; flagged as missing: 他尝很多植物，比方说茶、灵芝和夹竹桃。 | 所以，他吃一个香香的花而且那个花的味道很好。
S5: a person in blue stopped by and gave灵芝to 神农，神农felt better after eating灵芝
    the teacher's past decisions on other learners' versions of this scene -- accepted as told: 神农吃着植物，特别是灵芝。 | 神农问人帮他给他灵芝灵芝一吃就正好。 | 一个农民帮神农吃灵芝灵芝是夹竹桃毒的药。 ; flagged as missing: 他一吃灵芝就好了 | 他说，麻烦你给我拿个灵芝。然后，不病。
S6: another person in brown came by and had a conversation with 神农
    the teacher's past decisions on other learners' versions of this scene -- accepted as told: 正好有一个人帮他吃一个灵芝，一个别的人跟神农说，有很多花有毒，特别是夹竹桃，可以杀人。 | 神农的肚子最好以后，他问：穿着紫色衣服的男人怎么了？紫色人告诉他：你吃了灵芝，一吃就你的身体最好的。 | 他印象深刻，问年轻人给了他什么？他们说这是当地的一种药用植物。 ; flagged as missing: 他们告诉神农，他得吃得慢。 | 老板不可动，得问男人给他地方上像蘑菇一样的植物吃了。

learner's story:
在古代的时候，很麻烦地找吃的东西。神农很常走去找饭，他累死了。正好找到一个特别的花，他一吃就觉得很不舒服。因为这不是一个特别的花，是毒的花。两个人找他，不知道做什么。一个人看一个灵芝，问他的朋友，他应该给神农吃吧？朋友说：“这就要看灵芝是不是特别了。比方说，可能是毒的。”他们给神农灵芝。神农一吃身体就好极了。比方说，他可以又唱又跳。他把灵芝带回走了。人们都很高兴，因为他们有很多吃的东西。

scenes.core: Ancient people did not know edible plants and became sick
scenes.missing_part: People did not know which plants were safe to eat and often became sick after eating plants.

scenes.core: 神农 sets out to try plants for safe food
evidence: 神农很常走去找饭，他累死了。
scenes.missing_part: 神农 tries different plants to learn which ones are safe to eat and which are not.
details_left_out: He decided to do this because people did not know safe plants.

scenes.core: 神农 finds 茶 and records it
scenes.missing_part: 神农 finds 茶 and takes a record of it.

scenes.core: 神农 tries 夹竹桃 and becomes ill
evidence: 正好找到一个特别的花，他一吃就觉得很不舒服。
因为这不是一个特别的花，是毒的花。
details_left_out: The poisonous flower is named 夹竹桃.

scenes.core: A visitor gives 神农 灵芝, and he feels better
evidence: 神农一吃身体就好极了。
details_left_out: The person who gives 灵芝 is dressed in blue.

scenes.core: Another visitor comes and talks with 神农
evidence: 两个人找他，不知道做什么。
一个人看一个灵芝，问他的朋友，他应该给神农吃吧？
朋友说：“这就要看灵芝是不是特别了。比方说，可能是毒的。”
scenes.missing_part: The other person has a conversation with 神农, rather than only talking to a friend.
details_left_out: The other person is dressed in brown.

scenes.core: 神农 records 灵芝 and 夹竹桃
scenes.missing_part: 神农 takes a record of 灵芝 and 夹竹桃.

feedback: At the beginning, add that people did not know which plants were safe to eat, so they often became sick.
After 神农 starts looking for food, add that he tries different plants to learn which ones are safe.
Before he eats the poisonous flower, add that 神农 finds 茶 and writes it down.
After 神农 feels better from 灵芝, let the second person talk with 神农.
At the end, add that 神农 records 灵芝 and 夹竹桃.
